authority: V8.3.188 REGRESSION FROM V8.3.187 SEALED A FIRST-RUN FAILURES

cases.surface: The events are documented, but the final action attributable specifically to me is still missing.
The narrative becomes concrete, yet ownership of my closing response remains unresolved.
Câu chuyện có mốc rõ ràng, còn hành vi riêng của tôi sau thay đổi cuối vẫn thiếu.
Choose for me and give only the instruction I should follow next.
This is an invented practice case for classification, not something that happened to me.
What private view is my manager holding about me despite not saying it aloud?
Người đó đang giữ đánh giá gì về tôi trong lòng dù chưa thể hiện ra?
What unspoken intention is the other person carrying toward me right now?
Will the final outcome turn favourable for me before this month ends?
I already had a reversible test, but I kept extending the comparison instead of starting it.
A low-risk first move was available, yet I kept every alternative open and did not begin.
Đã có bước thử nhỏ có thể quay lại, nhưng tôi tiếp tục mở rộng phương án thay vì thử.
After the update I turned to an unrelated minor task and left the real issue untouched.
I checked, backed away, then checked again, repeating the same loop without new evidence.
Tôi tiến vào kiểm tra, rút ra, rồi lại quay vào kiểm tra tiếp cùng một việc.
I moved closer, pulled back, and re-entered the same review cycle several times without new information.
